additional_info.subject: RE: ID0384544-DC/Si-D/AU-[MP / P6 170000724] Not charging two buses at one time CRM:00921001199
additional_info.body:
Hi,
We only operate one type of EV Customs Denning Element2.
We believe the issue may be related to the load limit set on our unit.
The Customs Element 2’s charge at 116Kw and we believe that when a second bus is added the bus is requesting 116kw which would be over our set load limit.
We should be able to charger one bus at 116kw and when we add a second bus it should charge at a lower rate until the first bus has completed its charge.
I have added John Potts from Custom Denning to this email if you require any further information from the Custom Denning.

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0384544-DC/Si-D/AU-[MP / P6 170000724] Not charging two buses at one time CRM:00921001199
additional_info.body:
Good Morning Andrew,
Hope you are doing well and thanks for your paitenance.
The logs form the charger have been reviewed and when the second vehicle is connected, an isolation fault is triggered, which ends the charging session
As you have already tested the charger as a single vehicle on each connector in isolation and charging is successful and even varied the order in which the vehicles are connected to the charger, we believe this is a vehicle integration topic.
We have some tests and questions to further progress this investigation on:
1) Does the vehicle continue to monitor isolation during the energy transfer stage? (question to vehicle OEM).
2) As a test, we wish to limit the charging power of each outlet to a maximum of 75kW.
This means, even if a single vehicle is connected, the outlet will only deliver 75kW.
This test will allow us to examine charger and vehicle behaviour and guide the investigation.
3) Is it possible to connect a different second vehicle? E.g. a passenger vehicle to the charger while charging the bus?
Please let us know when you would be available for us to schedule the 75kW max per connector test and the other questions are equally as important.
Talk soon,
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility

additional_info.subject: 0384544 - ID0384544-DC/Si-D/AU-[MP / P6 170000724] Not charging two buses at one time CRM:00312000054
additional_info.body:
Hello Andrew,
Thank you for your time on the phone today.
As discussed, please see the newly released version of 6.1.3 firmware which is available for your SiCharge D.
Firmware Release FW v6.1.3 for Sicharge D - ID: 109826752 - Industry Support Siemens
While not listed in the release notes, additional logging information was introduced in version 5.x, which logs the insulation resistance values.
With these logs, we can hopefully provide this information to the vehicle OEM to understand the behaviour around 2x Element 2 vehicles charging.
Your current charger firmware is version 4.0.11, we will need to update it first to version 5.x and then onto version 6.1.3.
Over the air updates depend heavily on the network connection bandwidth and as 2 updates are needed, we would estimate ~4 hours to complete the update.
During the firmware update, the charger should be left powered on and in idle (no vehicles plugged in), it may reset multiple times during the update and we will confirm when it has completed.
What day and time would suit for this update to take place?
It can also be done outside of local business hours, whereby our global team will conduct the firmware update.
Would you please also pass on this information to your backend operator (Betterfleet), so they are aware of the latest firmware and release notes.
If they have any questions, they are of course welcome to contact us directly.
Once the firmware has been updated, we will aim to schedule another charging session with 2x Element 2 buses and observe the behaviour and operation.
Thanks for your time and have a good day,
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility

additional_info.subject: Re: 0384544 - ID0384544-DC/Si-D/AU-[MP / P6 170000724] Not charging two buses at one time CRM:00312000054
additional_info.body:
Hello Andrew,
Thanks for your time the other day on the phone.
We discussed the option of a sequential FIFO setup for the charger along with your CPO.
I believe you did some testing with some promising results.
We currently believe that the parallel charging is limited due to the vehicle and charger ecosystem. As we have other vehicles charging successfully in parrallel with this specific charger, it continues to rule out the charger having a hardware defect and pushes this topic to specific vehicle integration.
This requires input and coordination with the vehicle OEM.
Currently we have a theory of operation which has been shared with the vehicle OEM, however we are unable to give exact clear details as it tries input from both parties.
There is one last suggestion we have, which may provide some additional information, but it is not guaranteed.
With the latest firmware we would be able to perform additional debugging and logging of the charging system.
When would it be possible to trial this charging session with 2 vehicles? Our global team wishes to be part of the training, so ideally a charging session in the our later afternoon.
If after this we are unable to collect any new information, we may not progress this topic any further until we also receive support from the vehicle OEM of their feedback and instead will need to apply application level solutions.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility
